facts.text: John mentions that having a supportive team contributes to serving and protecting their community.

evidence.quote: We have different skills and talents, but they all contribute to serving and protecting our community.

facts.text: John states that the bond he feels with his team is similar to the bond he experienced during his time in the military.

evidence.quote: And it's a bond I haven't felt since my time in the military.

facts.text: John expresses that knowing they are all in this together and striving to keep their community safe is fulfilling and meaningful.

evidence.quote: It's nice to know we're all in this together, striving to keep our community safe. I find it fulfilling and meaningful.

facts.text: John acknowledges that he couldn't have completed the task without the support of his team, and they have become like family to him.

evidence.quote: I couldn't have done it without them. We trust and rely on one another, and it's great to know that we have each other's backs. They've become like family to me.
